scene: The gardener's copper key triggers three transit portals across the lawn.
picture: Flat side view. On the far left, a striped gondola drone hovers with tied ropes. Left-of-centre, the grandmother in pink tracksuit holds her white dog and the key. Centre sits a spiral tram on brass tracks. The robot stands beside it, while far right waits an open hover metro car.
shown: a striped gondola drone hovering gently on the far left
a brass spiral tram waiting at a curved track centre
a sleek hover metro car with open doors far right
